description: Plans a port of a project to another engine or language and creates the output project (scaffold). Every source file becomes a unit with a target path, action (translate, convert-scene, copy, rebuild), dependencies, API-usage count and risk, ordered dependencies-first. Engines: godot, godot-csharp, unity, unreal, threejs; or a language (typescript, python, csharp, cpp, rust, go…). The source is never modified; output must be a new or empty folder.

to.description: Target: godot, godot-csharp, unity, unreal, threejs or a language.

name: port_plan
title: Plan a port
